objective: Al terminar enfatizas con oraciones hendidas (It was Ana who…, What I need is…, The reason why…) para destacar la información clave.

warmup.prompt_es: 'Fue Ana quien lo dijo', 'Lo que necesito es descansar'. Las oraciones hendidas (cleft sentences) dividen la frase para poner el foco en una parte. Son muy útiles al hablar y escribir con énfasis.

text: When people talk about the success of Finnish schools, they often point to the tests. But it is not the tests that make the difference; it is the trust in teachers. What impresses visitors most is the lack of pressure. Students don't start formal schooling until they are seven, and what they do in the early years is mainly play.

It was a group of reformers in the 1970s who changed the system. What they wanted was equality, not competition. The reason why the model works is that every school receives similar funding, so a child's postcode doesn't decide their future.

What worries many experts now is not Finland's results but the influence of screens. It is concentration, rather than knowledge, that seems to be declining. All that teachers can do is encourage children to read more. And where Finland still leads is in the respect it gives to the teaching profession: it is a career that people compete to enter.
input.es: Cuando se habla del éxito de las escuelas finlandesas, a menudo se señalan los exámenes. Pero no son los exámenes los que marcan la diferencia; es la confianza en los profesores. Lo que más impresiona a los visitantes es la ausencia de presión. Los alumnos no empiezan la escolarización formal hasta los siete años y lo que hacen en los primeros años es sobre todo jugar. Fue un grupo de reformistas en los años setenta quien cambió el sistema. Lo que querían era igualdad, no competencia. La razón por la que el modelo funciona es que cada colegio recibe una financiación similar, así que el código postal de un niño no decide su futuro. Lo que preocupa ahora a muchos expertos no son los resultados de Finlandia sino la influencia de las pantallas. Es la concentración, más que el conocimiento, lo que parece estar disminuyendo. Todo lo que pueden hacer los profesores es animar a los niños a leer más. Y donde Finlandia sigue liderando es en el respeto que da a la profesión docente: es una carrera a la que la gente compite por acceder.

md_es: **Oraciones hendidas (cleft sentences)**
| Tipo | Estructura | Ejemplo |
| **It-cleft** | *It + be + elemento + that/who + resto* | ***It was Ana who** told me.* |
| **Wh-cleft (pseudo-cleft)** | *What / All / The thing + sujeto + verbo + is/was + elemento* | ***What I need is** a holiday.* |
| **Reason / place / time cleft** | *The reason why / The place where / The time when … is …* | ***The reason why** he left **is** simple.* |
| **All + be** | *All I want is …* | ***All I want is** peace and quiet.* |
| **Wh-cleft con verbo** | *What he did was (to) + verbo* | ***What he did was call** the police.* |
**It-cleft: foco**
- Sujeto: *It was Ana **who** broke the window.* (no Ben)
- Objeto: *It was the window **that** Ana broke.* (no la puerta)
- Tiempo/lugar: *It was in 2019 **that** they moved.* · *It was in Paris **where** we met.*
- Negación del foco: *It wasn't the tests that made the difference.*
**Wh-cleft**
- *What impresses me is her honesty.* · *What I like about it is the price.* · *What we need is more time.*
- Orden inverso: *A holiday is what I need.* · *Honesty is what impresses me.*
**Verbo to + infinitivo en wh-cleft**
- *What I did was (to) apologise.* (puede omitirse el *to* tras *did was*).
**Usos**
- Corregir información: *It was Tuesday we met, not Monday.* · Dar énfasis: *What matters is that you tried.* · Contraste: *It's not the money; it's the principle.*
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *It was Ana which told me.* → ✔ *It was Ana who told me.* (persona: who).
- ✘ *What I need it is a holiday.* → ✔ *What I need is a holiday.* (sin it).
- ✘ *It is the reason why I came.* (confuso) → ✔ *That is the reason why I came.*
- ✘ *The reason why is because …* → ✔ *The reason why … is that …*
**Ojo:** tras *the reason why … is* se usa *that*, no *because*. *All I want is …* se traduce 'lo único que quiero es…'. No abuses de las hendidas: usa una por párrafo para enfatizar.
Pronunciación: *reformer* /rɪˈfɔːmə/ · *equality* /ɪˈkwɒləti/ · *competition* /ˌkɒmpəˈtɪʃn/.
